headline: Dialogue with the PM today, NCP to present two conditions for unity

members.title: Dialogue with the PM today, NCP to present two conditions for unity
members.lead: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s dialogue, or exchange of views, with the political parties that participated in the July mass uprising begins today, Monday. At the prime minister’s invitation, the National Citizen Party (NCP), formed by the student leaders who led the uprising, is participating in the dialogue as the first party. In today’s talks, the party will present two conditions to the prime minister as the "first step" toward national unity. In the wake of subversive activities by the Awami League, whose activities are banned, the prime minister called upon anti-fascist political parties in the National Parliament on 18 November to come together on one platform. .PM to hold dialogue with political parties soon. Leader of the opposition Shafiqur Rahman also highlighted the necessity of unity among the parties that day. The prime minister and the leader of the opposition also spoke privately on the matter. In continuation of those developments, the prime minister’s dialogue with political parties begins today. As the first party, NCP leaders are sitting for discussions with the head of government at the State Guest House Jamuna this afternoon. A four-member delegation led by the party's convener and chief whip of the opposition in the National Parliament, Nahid Islam, will take part in the discussion. With the goal of national unity, the prime minister is also scheduled to hold successive discussions with other parties, including Jamaat-e-Islami. Jamaat Ameer and leader of the opposition in parliament Shafiqur Rahman left for a visit to Australia last Friday, from where he will travel to Malaysia. He is scheduled to return to the country on 26 November. members.title: PM to meet NCP delegation led by Nahid Islam at the Secretariat
members.lead: The National Citizen Party (NCP), formed by the student leaders who led the July mass uprising, is sitting for a dialogue with Prime Minister Tarique Rahman today, Monday. The dialogue will take place at 1:00 pm at the prime minister's office in the Cabinet Division at the Secretariat. Three leaders of the party, including NCP convener and chief whip of the opposition in the National Parliament Nahid Islam, will participate in the dialogue. The other two are NCP member secretary and member of parliament, Akhtar Hossain, and NCP senior joint convener and member of parliament Hasnat Abdullah.
